stem: What is the purpose of a harvest hold?
choices: To remove the source identity from the lot while review is pending.
To keep identified suspect or unresolved material out of normal flow until an authorized review and release/disposition decision occurs.
To allow unlabeled staging while the team decides what to do next.
To give Technician I independent authority to discard or release the material.
rationale: A hold is a controlled status used to prevent suspect or unresolved material from continuing through normal flow. It preserves identity and control while authorized review determines release, rework, destruction, or another disposition. It does not erase traceability or grant independent disposition authority.
